ambiguities.ambiguity: The specification names E_sha256 but does not define its preimage.
ambiguities.reading: Found by trying candidate encodings (no producer code read): sha256 of the UTF-8 compact JSON of the E_hex list, json.dumps(E_hex, separators=(',', ':')), hex digits lowercase without 0x and without leading zeros. Under this reading all 2100 archived E_sha256 values match, the E_hex strings are all in that canonical form, and for the 1100 curve-algebra systems the hash of MY rebuilt E (re-encoded) matches too. A different preimage convention would not change any other result.

ambiguities.ambiguity: Bit order of a solution integer is not stated.
ambiguities.reading: bit j of the integer = v_j (the monomial-mask convention). Every listed solution of every satisfiable control satisfies the system under this reading and the listed set equals my full solution set.

x_1 = sum_{j<10} v_j t^j is, as a field-element integer, bits 0..9 of the assignment integer; x_2 is bits 10..19. Follows from the text; recorded because descent route B and the direct S_3 zero count depend on it.

ambiguities.clause: FORMAT flat-v1: C = sorted list of (mu, k)
ambiguities.reading: Sorted by (mu as a tuple compared lexicographically, then k). All 1200 archived flat-v1 are sorted under this reading with no duplicate pair. The sum is order-independent, so sortedness is recorded as a format observation and never affects the identity verdict; a duplicated pair would be a format rejection.

ambiguities.ambiguity: The archived flat-v1 lines carry closure 'W_4' and max |mu| = 3.
ambiguities.reading: 'verified' reports the identity sum mu*f_k = 1 in B (it certifies unsatisfiability and 1 in rowspace(M_{2+max|mu|})). counts_toward_M4 and counts_toward_W4 are true only at max |mu| <= 2 ("It counts toward M_4 only when max |mu| <= 2, and NEVER toward W_4 unless max |mu| <= 2"). Tabulated separately from the wdag-v1 counts.

ambiguities.clause: FORMAT wdag-v1: node ids and rule (a)
ambiguities.ambiguity: Whether 'id' must equal the list position.
ambiguities.reading: id = list position 0..n-1 is required (a format rule); rule (a) 'every child c < i' is applied to ids; output must be a node id. All 1200 archived wdag-v1 conform.
mu is a strictly increasing list of variable indices in 0..19; |mu| = its length; j in prods must lie in 0..19. All archived certificates conform.
Degrees are taken after multilinear reduction (built into the representation); deg(0) = -1, so a zero node satisfies every bound. No archived node is zero.
depth(node with no prods) = 0; depth(i) = 1 + max depth(c) over prods children; the certificate's value is the maximum over nodes.

ambiguities.ambiguity: '(-degree, bitmask ascending)': which bit of the mask is v_i, and bit order of the hex.
ambiguities.reading: mask bit i = v_i; coordinates sorted by (-popcount, mask); bit c of int(L_hex[i], 16) (LSB first) = lambda on coordinate c; 6196 coordinates, v_0v_1v_2v_3 first, constant last (coordinate 6195), degree <= 3 block = coordinates 4845..6195. Self-tested: this order equals DESCENDING degrevlex with constant last as defined in EXP-CERTBIN-4e92d7 macaulay_matrix, consistent with the text's '= closure.column_order(4, 20)' (which I did not read).

Own M_4: mu over mu_order(2, 20) (211 monomials, degree ascending then lexicographic index tuple) times k in 0..18, row index mu_index * 19 + k, zero rows retained: 4009 rows; row = multilinear reduction of mu * f_k in the 6196 coordinates.

ambiguities.clause: FORMAT ann-v1 (A2): 'a basis K of S cap B_{<=3} computed by the verifier's own elimination'
ambiguities.reading: The null-space basis of L restricted to the 1351 degree <= 3 coordinates, from my own RREF (unit vector on each free column). By linearity any basis gives the same verdict. dim S = 6196 - rank(L) is recorded.

ann-v1 has no rows, k, mu or degree discipline; removing one functional does not guarantee invalidity, so it cannot be a must-reject control. ann-v1 kinds carry (e) transplant, (f), (g), (h). Declared not applicable, with this reason, in vc7_negative_controls.not_applicable.

ambiguities.ambiguity: Two constructions are named ('a prods child of degree 4, or a one-node wdag-v1 with |mu| = 3').
ambiguities.reading: Both are built, 5 each per wdag-v1 kind: (d1) a new node with one row (mu, k), |mu| = 2, deg(mu f_k) = 4, used twice as the same prods child [j, N] in a new output node that copies the old output (sum unchanged; only rule (c) violated); (d2) the same key's flat-v1 C as the rows of a one-node wdag-v1 (only rule (b) violated). For flat-v1 kinds, (d) = the archived flat-v1 (max |mu| = 3) submitted as an M_4 refutation.

ambiguities.clause: VC-7 (h) 'a system where your W_4 differs from M_4'
ambiguities.ambiguity: Which systems qualify and how 'differs' is decided.
ambiguities.reading: W_4 != M_4 iff W^(1) != W^(0) (EXP-CERTBIN-e94b27 iteration): decided by multiplying every RREF basis row of rowspace(M_4) whose pivot has degree <= 3 by every v_j and reducing against M_4. Searched over the systems of the same arm (all 250 for N-F219 and N-AFF19, both roles; the 200 unsatisfiable for N-ELL19, all of which qualify). Where none qualifies, (h) is vacuous and the annihilator of M_4 is recorded as a positive control (it must be accepted).
kind = (closure field, arm = key prefix before ':', format field).
slot i carries the x_R of S3-U400:i (S3-U400 index = primary-arm draw order). Every N-CONV19 record's s3_key equals 'S3-U400:<slot>' and its x_R equals that system's x_R.

ambiguities.clause: instance_sets N-ELL19 draw_rule 'row 18 REPLACED by ell_lin + c'
ambiguities.reading: Row 18 has exactly the ell_lin columns (v_j and v_{10+j} for j < 10 with Tr(t^j) = 1; own tau gives v_0 and v_10) and constant column = c in {0, 1}; every other column zero.

ambiguities.ambiguity: The text states the draw rule, not a checkable constraint.
ambiguities.reading: Derived constraint: E'^j is supported on supp(E^j), so the system lies inside U and, more tightly, inside supp(E^0) union (union over r_j = 1 of supp(E^j)) at the record's x_R. Both checked on all 250.

E^0 = E_S3(0) and E^j = E_S3(t^j) xor E^0 from my route-A descent with the literal B; U_k = union of supports; S_L = U cap columns 0..20. The affine decomposition E_S3(r) = E^0 + sum r_j E^j is checked on all 1100 curve-algebra systems.

RREF with columns in ann-v1 order (constant last): 1 in rowspace iff the constant column is a pivot column. The witness is checked by parity against every unreduced M_4 row, so it does not rely on the elimination being right.

second_route.method: each node evaluated as a function {0,1}^20 -> F_2 (tt(mu f_k) = tt(mu) AND tt(f_k), tt(v_j p) = tt(v_j) AND tt(p)); output must be the all-ones function; node degrees from the Moebius transform (ANF) of each node's truth table (code/run_certs_tt.py)

vc4_refutation_certificates.note_flat_v1: flat-v1 'verified' = the identity sum mu*f_k = 1 holds in B (certifies unsatisfiability and 1 in rowspace(M_{2+max|mu|})). counts_toward_M4 / counts_toward_W4 are true only at max |mu| <= 2 (FORMAT flat-v1).
